profile.purpose: source-locked fixed configuration; no target-label selection

graph_contract.relation_resolution: chain stages mapped to shared processing tiers exp_tier0..exp_tier5 using directional derived_from, derived_from_hs, and form_of stage edges
graph_contract.country_vocabulary: stage-level early graph countries, matching benchmark._build_labeled_triples
graph_contract.target_graph_visibility: target early graph visible as inference context in both modes

matched_modes.loco: parameters trained on other five chains only
matched_modes.in_domain: parameters trained on target chain early edges

graph_contract.permitted_transfer_drop: loco versus in_domain under this exact tier/dedup graph contract
graph_contract.forbidden_transfer_drop: never compare directly with the formal stage-relation graph; that mixes relation resolution, edge multiplicity, and vocabulary
